grants: at most 632 registered heldout controller operations

forbids: all further requests, fits, retries, successors, or scientific promotion

failure_routing.any_nonpass_or_invalid: seal partial leaf manifest, reconcile accounting, prove no retry/no further dispatch, run terminal review and claim lint, then HUMAN_TERMINAL
failure_routing.review_reject_or_invalid: permanently terminal for exact reviewed bytes; repair requires changed lock and new reviews

authority_token.hash: external over token bytes; token contains no self digest
authority_token.advance_rule: VALID_STAGE_PASS and two approving dispositions only

review_disposition.reviewer_separation: independent reviewer actor differs from every producer, author, implementer, and advocate; advocate may be an author or implementer but never reviewer
review_disposition.same_packet: both roles independently receive the identical immutable evidence packet excluding both review outputs
review_disposition.no_mutation: before and after reviewed artifact-set hashes equal; mutated reviewed paths empty
review_disposition.nonrecursive_rejection: transition reviewer rejection itself is terminal and needs no reviewer of the rejection

DEV_TO_HELDOUT: all 216 receipts or sealed partial manifest
HELDOUT_TO_LORA: Stage-T accounting noninterference and no-retry receipts
STAGE_L_TERMINAL: two fit input and output receipts

acceptance_tests.P1CB01: scope, source/runtime lock structure, call arithmetic, monotone authority, and terminal routing
acceptance_tests.P1CB02: public projection and final-request audit-taint noninterference
acceptance_tests.P1CB03: closed rows, self-check compatibility, duplicate reducer, provenance, depth, and conflict
acceptance_tests.P1CB04: reader, four corpus views, per-view touches, shared candidates, isolation, and matched mounts
acceptance_tests.P1CB05: all 31 exact shortcut vectors, proof masks, strict parser/scorer, and three-arm DEV headroom
acceptance_tests.P1CB06: 46/22/16 recurrence, literal zero-return M0, matched OWN/DIST forks, deterministic IDs and seeds
acceptance_tests.P1CB07: prospective heldout text organism plus donor, path, and matched-sham interventions
acceptance_tests.P1CB08: two pristine per-life adapters, separate 44/48 fidelity gates, own and donor behavior
acceptance_tests.P1CB09: resolved runtime, receipts, exact accounting, no hidden retry/truncation/cache/state
acceptance_tests.P1CB10: fresh review/advocate at every transition, claim firewall, mandatory human terminal

claim_firewall.text_pass: On the aligned v03r seed-5 twin pair, this exact strongly source/target-frontier-scaffolded prompted system produced model-self-supported typed rows and used registered life-local reader content on both fresh T-OWN decisions; the presealed donor, path-removal, and matched-sham interventions behaved as registered.
claim_firewall.goal_return_credit: Return-routing credit additionally requires T-OWN paired success; T-M0 and T-DIST paired loss; no NO_FOCUS; an OWN-only correctly typed model-self-supported focus-matching row; actual citation/use; donor tokens; path loss; and sham retention. It is only the effect of this fixed OWN-return treatment relative to these deterministic within-pair controls.
claim_firewall.lora_pass: Each exact per-life adapter achieved at least 44/48 presealed recognition cues and supported its registered immediate own/donor decision path.
claim_firewall.valid_failure: A valid failure must list prompt, model, schedule, reducer, reader, runtime, and optimization alternatives; it cannot uniquely localize a biological or architectural organ.

scope_stop: No outcome authorizes replication, prompt/model/rank/seed changes, Action World, lifetime scaling, LOOP adapters, rank pyramids, base promotion, publication, outreach, credentials, leases, or spend.
